adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the test at spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb only tests delegation (whether poll_feed is called) by mocking the entire poll_feed method. Looking at the actual poll_feed implementation in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb (lines 23-38), there is real logic for RSS parsing, field selection (i.link vs i.id fallback), HTML unescaping (CGI.unescapeHTML), and calling TopicEmbed.import - none of which is tested. The test file shows only 'poller.expects(:poll_feed).once' which completely bypasses this logic. This is a legitimate test coverage gap for newly added nontrivial code, not a bug but an important review concern.
